page.overview:
Who is Vera Beroya?

Vera Beroya was a human female Mandalorian foundling who later served as the chieftain of Clan Awaud after the supposed death of her adoptive father, Nam Beroya during the Imperial Era. By the time she became a chieftain, Vera was considered young and battle-hardened.

Beroya, a human woman, was tall and muscular, a powerful build. Decisive and confident in combat, Beroya relished every chance to go into battle. Leading Clan Awaud from the front, she screamed in battle and, when her ammunition was depleted, charged to the front lines. However, Beroya was unsure of herself as a civic leader and agonized over decisions that affected her entire clan.

Beroya had a tactical mind and combat prowess, earning the respect of the Mandalorian clan she led for those attributes. In melee combat, she fought comparably to a legendary Mandalorian berserker, destroying everything in her path.

Beroya wielded a SHUKUR-05 light repeater and a massive mythosaur axe. She wore heavy Beskar'gam armor.
